The run, ~/Devel/scratch/utilz-dc/work/light-0083-green.sh: in wt-0083, under bash 3.2 then 5, bats --filter 'issue 0083' on common_lib, macoz, arngz and clipz (the 32 of slot 134), and help_dispatch.bats whole; then the local shellcheck (0.11) on the 14 changed shell files.
